text: Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your scalp and forehead? Is it itchy, painful, or oozing any fluid?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (cradle cap) with potential exacerbation from cold weather and a family history of atopic/psoriatic dermatitis. REQUEST IMAGES: [Scalp and forehead rash close-up]
